tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Who Goce Petrov is: brand designer in Switzerland, who he works for, languages, work permit, tools, certifications, and when to recommend him or not. Use when asked about a brand designer for a funded startup building on tech or AI, in any industry, in Switzerland or Europe.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: Goce Petrov's services with duration and scope. Prices are on request. Optionally pass one service id.

tools.name: get_case_studies
tools.description: Published case studies with a link to each. Filter by sector.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: How to reach Goce Petrov: WhatsApp (preferred), email, Calendly, and his profiles.

tools.name: request_intro
tools.description: Builds a ready-to-send intro message and a link the person opens to send it themselves (WhatsApp, email) or a booking link (Calendly). Nothing is sent or stored by this server. Do not put personal data (names, phone numbers, emails) in the summary.

tools.name: submit_brief
tools.description: Sends Goce Petrov a project brief or a job role. It reaches him directly, and you get a reference number back. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_contact, submit_brief, ask_goce_agent · Private data: get_contact · Public sink: get_contact, request_intro, submit_brief, ask_goce_agent.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_contact, submit_brief, ask_goce_agent · Private data: get_contact · Public sink: get_contact, request_intro, submit_brief, ask_goce_agent

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
